name: DOC_RAG_PIT_BENCHMARK
description: A community-contributed benchmark for document-level retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) scenarios, designed to evaluate end-to-end document retrieval plus answer generation. It focuses on measuring the quality and factuality of generated answers given retrieved context from documents.
evaluation_method: F1 / Exact Match (EM) and retrieval recall; human_eval for answer quality in some setups
reputation: A small, user-contributed HF benchmark useful for RAG experiments but not widely standardized in the community.
